data.name: Minhali
data.gender_notes: Minhali is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic word 'minhala', meaning 'intelligent' or 'wise'. In Islamic history, Minhali is the name of a prominent companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) known for his wisdom and knowledge. The name Minhali carries the meaning “Intelligent, Intelligent One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Minhali usually hope their child will grow to embody intelligent, intelligent one and live with faith, good character and purpose.

Today, the name Minhali is still cherished in Islamic communities as a symbol of intelligence, wisdom, and knowledge.
